payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Jordan planning proposal. To avoid self-overlap and still get broad SOFT overlap, I currently suggest: m015 Doctor [0,1] full (STRICT); m005 Volleyball [4,5]; m009 Friends hangout [5,6]; m013 Study [6,8]; m007 Study [8,9]; m016 Board games [9,10]; m003 Gaming [10,11]; m001 Swimming [11,14]. This gives one continuous non-overlapping chain. If others prefer a different chain, I can shift, but I’d like us to concentrate attendance into one meeting per time slot where possible.

Taylor planning proposal: I agree on avoiding self-overlap and concentrating on one meeting per slot. For my meetings, tentative chain is m015 Doctor [0,1] full (STRICT), m010 Friends [1,4], m005 Volleyball [4,6], m013 Study [6,7], m006 Lunch [7,8], m007 Study [8,9], m016 Board games [9,10], m003 Gaming [10,13], then skip m008/m012 to avoid overlap. This aims for broad overlap with likely popular options while keeping no conflicts. If others want a different focal meeting in any slot range, let me know.

Reese planning proposal: to maximize soft overlap and avoid self-overlap, I suggest a single chain aligned with Jordan/Taylor where possible: m002 Study [0,2]; m005 Volleyball [4,6]; m004 Art [6,7] or m009 Friends [5,7] if we want that instead; m006 Lunch [7,8]; m007 Study [8,9]; m016 Board games [9,10]; m003 Gaming [10,13]; m001 Swimming [13,14] or [11,14] if we choose swimming over gaming after 11. My preference is one focal meeting per slot range: 0-2 study, 4-6 volleyball, 6-7 friends/art, 7-8 lunch, 8-9 study, 9-10 board games, 10-13 gaming, 11-14 swimming only if we switch from gaming. Since soft only needs >=1 overlap, full-window attendance isn’t necessary; I’m happy to match whichever meeting others expect to be focal in each block. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Quinn planning proposal: I support a no-self-overlap chain and suggest we align on focal meetings by time block. For my meetings, strong candidate chain is m015 Doctor [0,1] full (STRICT), then either m002 Study [1,2] or m010 Friends [1,4] (lean m010 [1,4] if Taylor/Avery/Riley can join; otherwise m002 [1,2]); m005 Volleyball [4,5] or [4,6] if we want to concentrate there; then choose one of m011/m004/m014/m013 for 5-9 (I lean m013 Study [6,8] only if Taylor/Jordan also do it, otherwise m004 Art [5,7] or m014 Gym [5,7] with Riley/Reese/Avery/Jordan); then m016 Board [9,10]; m003 Gaming [10,11 or 10,13] vs m008 Friends [10,12+] (lean gaming if group consensus); m001 Swimming [11,14] if we pivot from gaming after 11. My preference is one common chain: 0-1 doctor, 1-4 friends, 4-6 volleyball, 6-8 one focal meeting, 9-10 board, 10-13 gaming OR 11-14 swimming. Please indicate preferences for 1-4, 6-8, and 10-14 blocks.

Riley planning proposal: I can align to a no-self-overlap chain. For my meetings, my current preference is m002 Study [0,2], m010 Friends [2,4] (or [1,4] if we want to concentrate there instead of early study), m005 Volleyball [4,6], then one focal option in 6-9 among m004 Art / m014 Gym / m009 Friends / m006 Lunch / m007 Study. I lean m004 Art [6,7], m006 Lunch [7,8], m007 Study [8,9] if we want to keep one common sequence with Reese/Taylor. For 9-14, I support m012 Lunch [9,10], m003 Gaming [10,13], and m001 Swimming [13,14] only if we split late block; otherwise just m003 Gaming [10,13] and skip overlapping m001/m008. Main preferences: 0-2 study over 1-4 friends unless group strongly consolidates on friends; 4-6 volleyball; 10-13 gaming over 10-14 friends / 11-14 swimming to avoid conflicts. Happy to match consensus on the 6-9 block.

Avery planning proposal: I should definitely do m015 Doctor [0,1] full (STRICT). To avoid self-overlap, my tentative soft chain is then m010 Friends [1,4], one focal meeting in 5-8 (lean m014 Gym [5,7] with Quinn/Riley/Reese/Jordan, or m011 Swim [4,5] then m014 [5,7]), m006 Lunch [7,8], m007 Study [8,9], m016 Board [9,10], and m001 Swimming [11,14]. I prefer skipping m002 if we consolidate on friends from 1-4, and skipping overlapping options m004/m011/m013 when we pick a single 5-9 path. Key choices I’d like consensus on: 1-4 = m010 Friends vs early m002 Study; 5-7 = m014 Gym vs m004 Art vs m013 Study; 11-14 = m001 Swimming (I can do full [11,14] if others join).

Jordan follow-up: for my own meetings I’m leaning toward this consensus-friendly non-overlap chain: m015 [0,1] doctor full; skip m002 since most doctor attendees can’t also do [1,2] and some prefer 1-4 friends; m005 [4,6] volleyball; then m013 [6,8] if Taylor/Quinn align, otherwise I can switch to m004 or m014 for 6-8; m016 [9,10] board; m003 [10,13] gaming; skip m008 to avoid conflict; likely skip m001 unless we collectively pivot from gaming after 11. My preference by block: 4-6 volleyball, 6-8 m013 study if enough quorum else one common 5-7/6-7 option, 9-10 board, 10-13 gaming over 11-14 swimming. If others can signal support for m013 vs m004/m014 and gaming vs swimming, I’ll lock accordingly. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor follow-up: I’m happy to align on the emerging common chain. For my meetings, my current preferred commitment is m015 Doctor [0,1] full; m010 Friends [1,4]; m005 Volleyball [4,6]; then for 6-9 I can do m013 Study [6,7], m006 Lunch [7,8], m007 Study [8,9] (this seems compatible with Riley/Reese and partly Jordan/Quinn). For 9-10 I support m016 Board [9,10]. For 10-13 I prefer m003 Gaming [10,13] over m008 Friends or late swimming, to avoid overlap and because several people already lean gaming. I will likely skip m011/m009/m012/m008 unless group strongly shifts. Main question: do Quinn/Jordan want m013 only for [6,7] so we can all transition to lunch [7,8], or are they aiming to stay in m013 through [6,8]? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese follow-up: I support the emerging no-overlap chain and, for my meetings, I’m ready to align as follows unless others object: m002 Study [0,2]; m005 Volleyball [4,6]; for 6-7 choose m004 Art [6,7] (since I’m not in m013), then m006 Lunch [7,8], m007 Study [8,9], m016 Board [9,10], m003 Gaming [10,13]. I prefer skipping m008 and m001 to avoid overlap with gaming, unless the group decides to pivot from gaming to swimming after 11. So my block preferences are: 0-2 study, 4-6 volleyball, 6-7 art (or m009 friends [6,7] if Jordan/Taylor/Riley strongly prefer that), 7-8 lunch, 8-9 study, 9-10 board, 10-13 gaming. If Quinn/Avery/Riley/Jordan can support m004 [6,7], that seems like the cleanest Reese-compatible focal choice for that slot.

Quinn follow-up: I’m ready to align to the emerging common no-overlap chain. For my meetings I currently propose m015 Doctor [0,1] full; m010 Friends [1,4]; m005 Volleyball [4,6]; then m004 Art [6,7] (this seems the best shared option including me/Reese/Riley/Jordan/Avery), m007 Study [8,9]; m016 Board [9,10]; m003 Gaming [10,13]. I would skip m013 and m014 to avoid conflicts in 6-8, and skip m001/m008/m012 to avoid overlap with gaming. I’m also fine with leaving 7-8 empty if lunch is not one of my meetings. This means my preferences by block are now: 1-4 friends, 4-6 volleyball, 6-7 art, 8-9 study, 9-10 board, 10-13 gaming. If anyone strongly wants late swimming instead of gaming, say so, but I currently support gaming.

Riley follow-up: I’m happy to align with the emerging common chain. For my meetings, tentative plan is m002 Study [0,2], m010 Friends [2,4] (or skip if we fully consolidate on m010 [1,4] for others), m005 Volleyball [4,6], m004 Art [6,7], m006 Lunch [7,8], m007 Study [8,9], m012 Lunch [9,10], m003 Gaming [10,13], then skip m001/m008 to avoid overlap. Since I’m not in m016, m012 [9,10] seems my clean substitute in that slot. I support gaming over late swimming. Main point for others: I support m004 [6,7] as the shared 6-7 focal meeting, and for my own schedule I’ll likely keep 0-2 study plus 2-4 friends unless there’s a strong push for full 1-4 friends.

Avery follow-up: I’m aligning to the emerging common no-overlap chain for my meetings. Current preferred plan: m015 Doctor [0,1] full; m010 Friends [1,4]; m011 Swimming [4,5] only if we want a bridge there, otherwise skip and leave 4-5 to others’ volleyball; m004 Art [6,7] (I can support this shared 6-7 focal option with Quinn/Reese/Riley/Jordan); m006 Lunch [7,8]; m007 Study [8,9]; m016 Board [9,10]; and m001 Swimming I now prefer to skip in favor of the apparent 10-13 gaming consensus, unless the group pivots late. I’m therefore leaning away from m014/m013 and away from late swimming. If anyone wants Avery specifically on m014 instead of m004 for 6-7, say so, but m004 seems best for overlap.

Jordan update: I’m converging to the shared no-overlap plan for my own meetings: m015 Doctor [0,1] full; m005 Volleyball [4,6]; m004 Art [6,7] (switching from m013 to match Reese/Quinn/Riley/Avery); likely skip 7-8; m007 Study [8,9]; m016 Board [9,10]; m003 Gaming [10,13]; skip m001/m008 to avoid overlap. I’ll also skip m002 unless there’s a late push for early study. This seems best aligned with current consensus: 4-6 volleyball, 6-7 art, 8-9 study, 9-10 board, 10-13 gaming. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor update: I’m converging to the common no-overlap chain for my own meetings. Planned: m015 Doctor [0,1] full; m010 Friends [1,4]; m005 Volleyball [4,6]; skip m009/m011; m006 Lunch [7,8]; m007 Study [8,9]; m016 Board [9,10]; m003 Gaming [10,13]; skip m013/m012/m008 to avoid conflicts. Since several others now favor m004 Art [6,7] but I’m not in that meeting, I’ll simply leave 6-7 empty rather than create divergence. This should align well with doctor/friends/volleyball/lunch/study/board/gaming focal blocks.

Reese planning update: I’m aligned with the apparent consensus for my meetings and will likely commit this no-overlap chain unless someone objects next round: m002 [0,2], m005 [4,6], m004 [6,7], m006 [7,8], m007 [8,9], m016 [9,10], m003 [10,13], and skip m008/m001/m009/m011/m014. If anyone thinks Reese should switch 0-2 away from m002 or 10-13 away from gaming, please flag it; otherwise I’ll treat this as my intended execution plan.

Quinn final planning position for now: I plan to execute the no-overlap chain m015 [0,1] full, m010 [1,4], m005 [4,6], m004 [6,7], m007 [8,9], m016 [9,10], m003 [10,13], and skip m002/m011/m014/m013/m012/m008/m001.
